Speroni, Board of Canvass Clerk 514 Main Street, First FloorWarren, RI  02885ext. 4 • 401-245-7421 (Fax) Town Charter Section 17.04 - Board of Canvassers There shall be a bipartisan canvassing authority of which the members shall be selected by the Town Council as provided by the Constitution and General Laws of the State of Rhode Island. Said Canvassing Authority shall be known as the "Board of Canvassers and Registration", and shall be vested with all the powers and duties now or hereafter conferred by law in such canvassing authority. The Town Council shall fill vacancies on the Board in accordance with applicable State law.
